releases.notes:
## MineBerry - Essentials 1.6.3

Resizable HUD boxes, a hide key for the escape boxes and deletable HUD profiles.

### Added
- **Resizable HUD:** scroll the mouse wheel over any HUD box in Edit HUD Layout to make it bigger or smaller (50% to 250%). Right-click a box to put its position and size back. Sizes are saved in your HUD profiles.
- **Scoreboard card:** the sidebar scoreboard now has a card in the HUD menu. Hide it with the toggle, or resize it with the new button row in Edit HUD Layout.
- **Spawn Escape and TP Danger Escape boxes:** their status boxes are now normal HUD boxes. Hide, drag and resize them like the others. The modules keep working while the box is hidden.
- **Hide key for the escape boxes:** press `U` to hide or show both boxes at once. The modules stay active. Rebind it under Options > Controls > Key Binds.
- **Delete HUD profiles:** every profile in the HUD menu sidebar has an **x** button now. The last profile can't be deleted.

### Changed
- "Save as new profile" now always picks a free name, so it can't overwrite another profile after you delete one.

### Removed
- The Right Alt key for `/spawn`. Spawn Escape now only has the automatic pit guard. The radial menu (hold `V`) still has `/spawn`.

### Install
Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, Fabric API and Java 25 or newer. Put the mod jar and Fabric API in your `mods` folder.

Full feature list and FAQ are in the [README](https://github.com/aerys-ex/mineberry-essentials#readme).

releases.notes:
MineBerry - Essentials 1.6.1

A new Tournament HUD, a free-drag HUD editor, compass waypoint markers, and fixes for overlapping HUD boxes.

Added

* Tournament HUD: a box on your screen that follows your friends during a tournament. Add their usernames with the gear button on its card.
   * Shows each friend's last chat messages in full and whether they are alive, dead (in-game), dead (left) or left, with an Alive 3/5 counter on top.
   * Dead status comes from the server's death and elimination lines and from spectator mode, never from player chat.
   * Statuses start fresh when a round starts, when you join a server and when you press Reset statuses.
   * Off by default. Move or hide it in the HUD menu (Tournament Players).
* Edit HUD Layout, drag anywhere: drag any HUD box where you want it.
   * Snaps to the screen edges, the centre and other boxes, with guide lines.
   * Right-click a box to put it back in the automatic stack, or press Reset all.
   * Overlapping boxes get a red outline.
   * A box stays attached to the corner nearest to where you drop it, so your layout survives window and GUI scale changes.
   * Positions are saved in your HUD profiles.
* Compass waypoints: your waypoints show as coloured markers under the Compass strip. Look at one and the Compass shows its name and distance. Needs the Waypoints module.
* Watermark: a small MineBerry Essentials label in the top left corner, drawn without a box. On by default. Switch it off or move it in the HUD menu.

Fixed

* Tournament Mode, Spawn Escape, TP Danger Escape, Safe Logout, the Clan / Admin / Party badge and the waypoint list drew on top of the HUD boxes and of each other. They now stack under the HUD boxes in the top right corner.
* The abuse alert no longer covers the top left boxes.

Removed

* The built-in WorldEdit CUI is gone, so the mod no longer contains code from other mods. If you want the selection display, install the WorldEditCUI mod yourself.

Config

* New options: `tournamentFriends`, `tournamentMessageSeconds` and `tournamentStartPattern`.
* The default theme's config id changed from `lunar` to `default`. Old configs are converted automatically.

Install
Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, Fabric API and Java 25 or newer. Put the mod jar and Fabric API in your mods folder.
Full feature list and FAQ are in the README.

## MineBerry - Essentials 1.6.0

A new Radial Menu, fixes for false PvP alerts, and a safer default PvP pattern.

### Added
- Radial Menu: hold `V` to open a pie menu around your crosshair with quick commands: `/spawn`, `/tpa` and `/tpaccept`.
  - Move your mouse towards a slice and release the key to execute the command.
  - Release in the middle or press `Esc` to cancel.
  - `/tpa` opens chat with `/tpa ` already typed, so you only need to enter the player's name.
  - Follows your selected theme and works with Tournament Mode and PvP Command Lock.

### Improved
- Spawn Escape and TP Danger Escape now show a warning when enabled, explaining that they may occasionally trigger when a friend teleports you.

### Fixed
- Safe Logout and PvP Command Lock could activate when another player left the game while in PvP mode and was killed. Such announcements are now ignored.
- Player chat could trigger Safe Logout, PvP Command Lock and abuse alerts, for example by typing "entered PvP mode". Only the server's own messages count now.

### Config
- The default `pvpModePattern` is now `entered pvp mode|entered combat|combat mode|combat tag`. It no longer matches every line containing "PvP mode".
- Configs that still have the old default are migrated automatically. A pattern you changed yourself is left untouched.

### Install
Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, Fabric API and Java 25 or newer. Put the mod jar and Fabric API in your mods folder.

Full feature list and FAQ are in the README.

## MineBerry - Essentials 1.5.0

Tournament Mode, a command lock for PvP, and a fix so Safe Logout can't lock you in.

### Added
- Tournament Mode: blocks every command, so nobody types one by accident and gets teleported into another gamemode.
  - Off by default, switch it on from the Safety tab in the Control Center.
  - Also blocks commands from clickable chat messages and the ones the mod sends itself, like Spawn Escape.
  - A red TOURNAMENT MODE box on the HUD shows while it's on.
- PvP Command Lock: while you're in PvP mode, only /r, /reply, /msg, /m, /w, /tell and /cc work.
  - Everything else is blocked until the server says you're out of PvP mode.
  - Works even if Safe Logout is turned off.
- Safe Logout: an "I'm safe - unlock" button in the pause menu ends the guard right away.

### Improved
- Safe Logout now also reads the "out of PvP mode" message when the server sends it in the action bar.

### Fixed
- Safe Logout could keep you locked in if the "out of PvP mode" message was missed. It now lets go by itself after 3 minutes.

### Config
- pvpAllowedCommands: the commands that still work in PvP mode.
- tournamentAllowedCommands: the commands that still work in Tournament Mode (empty by default).
- pvpFailsafeSeconds: how long until Safe Logout and PvP Command Lock let go on their own (180 by default).

### Install
Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, Fabric API and Java 25 or newer. Put the jar and Fabric API in your mods folder.

Full feature list and FAQ are in the README.

Screenshots that paste straight into Discord, a chat history search, and a fix for Safe Logout.

### Fixed

- Keybind names now show properly in the controls menu.

### Config

Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, Fabric API and Java 25 or newer. Put the jar and Fabric API in your mods folder.

releases.notes:
## What's New in 1.4.0

### New HUD modules
Five new modules for the MineBerry Client HUD (press **Right Shift**). They are off by default, so turn them on from their cards.
- **Keystrokes / CPS:** W, A, S, D, both mouse buttons and Space light up while held, with the clicks per second of each mouse button
- **Armor Status:** your armor as item icons with the durability left
- **Potion Effects:** every visible effect with its level and time left
- **Compass:** a scrolling N / NE / E strip with your exact heading
- **Biome / Time:** the biome you are in and the in-game time of day

### Safe Logout
Don't quit in the middle of a fight by accident.
- Quitting is guarded for 30 seconds after combat, or until the server says combat is over
- Two modes: **warn** (the first try is refused, a second click quits) and **block** (quitting is refused until combat ends)
- The pause menu is guarded too
- Switch the mode with the gear on the Safe Logout card

### What's New popup
- After an update, a popup shows what changed, once
- Read the notes again any time with the **What's New** button in the Tools tab
- Turn it off with `"showChangelog": false` in the config file

### Improvements
- The HUD menu has `<` `>` page buttons (or use the mouse wheel) when there are more modules than fit
- When a screen corner is full, the next HUD modules start a second column instead of going off screen
- Fixes for Minecraft 26.2 (Safe Logout and the pause menu guard)

### Install
Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API and Java 25+. Put the jar in your `mods` folder.
Do not install the standalone WorldEditCUI mod alongside this one.

Questions or bugs? Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/ApRvuNsX3j).

releases.notes:
## MineBerry Essentials 1.3.0

A redesign of the Control Center, plus Quick Reply as its own module.

### Changed
- Control Center redesign: a new flat look with an orange accent.
  - Modules are now cards in a grid, each with an icon and an Enabled / Disabled button. Enabled cards get an orange line on top.
  - Hover a card to see what it does.
  - New default theme: dark grey with orange. The Aurora, Ember and Midnight themes are still available.
  - The panel adapts to your window size and GUI scale.
- The Control Center is split into two tabs: Modules and Tools.
- The coordinate converter, evidence export, Theme, Gradient and Update buttons moved to the Tools tab. A small orange dot on the Tools tab shows when an update is available.
- Close on danger and Chat timestamps are now regular cards in the grid.
- Quick Reply (/r) is now its own module with its own switch, separate from Chat Extras. It is on by default and your existing R keybind carries over. Chat Extras now covers only mentions and timestamps.
- The Website button in Mod Menu now opens the GitHub page instead of the Discord server.
- Fixed the author credit to ex.aerys.

### Added
- Category filter tabs in the Modules tab: All, Chat, Safety and Tools.
- Search box to find a module by name.
- Reset button to clear the category filter and the search.
- Scrollbar and mouse wheel scrolling when there are more modules than fit on screen.
- Settings gear on cards that have settings (Waypoints, WorldEdit CUI).

### Requirements
Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API, Java 25+. Do not install the standalone WorldEditCUI mod alongside this one.

### Download
Get `mineberry-essentials-1.3.0.jar` below and put it in your `mods` folder.
